request.text: Cinematic close pass of two massive armored spacecraft. Immediate sub-heavy turbine punch, layered throaty engine roar, brutally precise steel docking-clamp slams, hydraulic braking. A three-stage performance: approach surge, synchronized heavy stop, brief resonant pressure decay. Isolated dry effect. No voice, music, UI beeps or silence.
